info.title: AIN Mobile API Contract
info.description: Flutter-facing contract for the mobile endpoints currently implemented in the Laravel API.

post.summary: Sign in and create a device-aware session.
Create a personal account and send email verification.
Verify account email and return a mobile session.
Reset password using the emailed code.
Rotate the refresh token and return a fresh access token.

get.summary: List active sessions with mobile installation metadata.
Preview a workspace invitation before accepting it.

post.summary: Accept a workspace invitation as the authenticated user.
Register or refresh the current Firebase Cloud Messaging token.

delete.summary: Revoke a push token by token value or installation ID.

get.summary: Return stable error codes with localized mobile messages.
Return app and web route templates for mobile navigation.
Return mobile cache TTLs, storage classes, and purge triggers.
Return mobile device and active-session limits.
Create a short-lived signed stream URL for a protected content item.

post.summary: Record mobile viewer security and lifecycle events.

get.summary: List published courses available to public mobile clients.
Get a published course detail by ID or slug.

post.summary: Create a public booking request for a course batch.

get.summary: Get authenticated student enrollment access state.
List published organization content visible to the current user, optionally scoped to a room.
List organization booking requests for owner/admin workflows.

post.summary: Confirm an organization booking through the backend transaction endpoint.
Reject an organization booking through the backend transaction endpoint.
Cancel an organization booking through the backend transaction endpoint.

get.summary: List organization courses for owner/admin mobile review.
List organization course batches for owner/admin mobile review.
List workspace invitations for the selected organization.

post.summary: Create a workspace invitation for an organization role.

get.summary: List visible organization rooms for the active user.

post.summary: Create a room through the backend organization policy.
